summary.text: Napoleon Nelson is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 154, having taken office on December 1, 2020, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes working as a financier.

paragraphs.text: Nelson graduated from Central High School in 1998, earned a degree from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 2002, and received an M.B.A. from the University of Pennsylvania in 2007.
His career experience includes working as a financier.

In the 2023-2024 session, Nelson was assigned to the Aging & Older Adult Services, Appropriations, Children & Youth, and Education committees, and was subcommittee chair on Criminal Justice for Appropriations.
